subject: Home Economics
sourceFile: Copy of Prevocational Studies BECE Syllabus - syllabusNG.txt
examFormat: Pre-Vocational Studies (PVS) integrates Agriculture and Home Economics; it aims to develop candidates' interest in Agriculture and Home Economics, help them acquire basic knowledge, enlighten them on the occupational areas in Pre-Vocational Studies, and appreciate the dignity of labour and entrepreneurship. BECE Pre-Vocational Studies has two compulsory papers of sixty multiple-choice questions each, lasting one hour each; together they are weighted 70%, with 30% from school Continuous Assessment. Home Economics is examined in Paper 2: sixty multiple-choice questions in one hour.
excluded: Left out the syllabus.ng "About Us", "About BECE", eligibility, grading, registration, table of contents and FAQ chapters (publisher marketing / general information, not syllabus content). The Agriculture theme (Paper 1) is in its own file.
recommendedTexts: Seagrove Pre-Vocational Studies for Schools and Colleges, Books 1, 2 and 3 — Emmanuel O. Onazi and Afolabi I. Ademola (Seagrove Publishers Limited, Ibadan)
